qualifier: adipocyte fate and PPAR signaling control, without fatty acid transport or storage
name: Adipose development, PPAR signaling and cold-induced thermogenesis
rationale: All members concern adipose tissue development (white, brown and beige adipocyte differentiation and proliferation, PPARG/PPAR signaling control) and cold- or diet-induced thermogenesis; unlike its superset confusable it lacks fatty acid transport, fatty acid cycling, lipid droplet and leptin members, so the name stresses developmental and PPAR regulation.

qualifier: fatty acid transport, cycling and lipid storage
name: Adipocyte differentiation, thermogenesis and fatty acid transport
rationale: Members cover white, brown and beige adipocyte differentiation, PPAR signaling and cold/diet-induced thermogenesis, and additionally fatty acid transport, the fatty acid cycling model, lipid droplet fusion and the leptin adipocyte module, which distinguish it from the narrower adipose development theme and from the LXR/ChREBP lipid-metabolism confusable.

core: Wnt ligand secretion and non-canonical Wnt/Ca2+ signaling
qualifier: porcupine-dependent secretion, no canonical receptor arm
name: Porcupine-mediated Wnt secretion and non-canonical Wnt/Ca2+ signaling
rationale: All members concern either PORCN-dependent Wnt ligand biogenesis/secretion (LGK974, ligand trafficking, secretion regulation) or the non-canonical Wnt/calcium pathway (WNT5A-FZD2/5-ROR2, Ca2+ pathway); unlike its superset it has no canonical LRP5/DVL/TCF-antagonist members, and unlike the PCP and retinal-vascular confusables it includes ligand secretion.

core: Wnt ligand secretion and Wnt/Ca2+ signaling
qualifier: receptor-level canonical engagement (LRP5, DVL activation, ligand antagonists)
name: Wnt ligand secretion and receptor-level canonical and Ca2+ signaling
rationale: Members span Wnt ligand biogenesis and secretion (PORCN, Golgi trafficking), non-canonical Wnt/Ca2+ signaling, and receptor-level canonical events (LRP5 mutants, DVL activation, DKK/SFRP antagonists), which distinguish it from the secretion/Ca2+-only subset and from destruction-complex and RNF43/FZD-ubiquitination confusables lacking secretion.
